mentions.name: RomM
mentions.description: This is a self-hosted ROM manager and player. Its 5.0 release adds a save sync engine so game saves can move between devices, letting users start playing on a PC and pick up where they left off on another device such as the AYN Thor handheld.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Three years in and I'm still working on RomM (https://github.com/rommapp/romm), a self-hosted ROM manager and player.

Our latest 5.0 release includes a save sync engines, so your game saves can move between devices (compatible app required). Start playing on your PC, save + sync, grab your AYN Thor and pick up where you left off.
mentions.author: gassi
